definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to nouns to indicate a side, direction, or perspective. Can indicate physical location (left side, right side) or abstract perspective (the customer's side, the company's side).

examples.japanese: ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧{側|がわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please walk on the right side.
I'd like a seat on the window side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧{側|がわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧{側|がわ} (right side)
- ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧{側|がわ} (left side)
- ⟦{向|む}こう→向こう：00971_mukou⟧{側|がわ} (the other side, opposite side)
- ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧{側|がわ} (this side)
- ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧{側|がわ} (window side)
- ⟦{通路|つうろ}→通路：04062_tsuuro⟧{側|がわ} (aisle side)
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧{側|がわ} (mountain side)
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧{側|がわ} (sea side)

ABSTRACT USES:
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧{側|がわ} (customer's side/perspective)
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧{側|がわ} (company's side)
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧{側|がわ} (parents' side)

RELATED: ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧ (back side, reverse), ⟦{表側|おもてがわ}→表側：25112_omotegawa⟧ (front side).
